Messages.Body:
If I lose pool on my untap (Via AR, or other methods) My withdraw
attempt fails, so the withdraw happens after all my untap has no pool
lose/spending or minions losing/spending blood or getting in combat...

So here's my question...

Ok, if I wanted to withdraw... And told my predator, if I withdrew
successfully, I'll tap the succubuss club and give him all my
stuff(Vampires, cards in play, but not pool) prior to my withdraw... Is
that possible?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Kulaid wrote:
> If I lose pool on my untap (Via AR, or other methods) My withdraw
> attempt fails, so the withdraw happens after all my untap has no pool
> lose/spending or minions losing/spending blood or getting in combat...

No. Attempting to withdraw is an event you can order among the other untap
events. You can announce (begin) your attempt to withdraw after handling
all of the pool loss effects.

Then, when your next untap comes around, you successfully withdraw before
handling any of the pool loss events in that new untap.

> So here's my question...
>
> Ok, if I wanted to withdraw... And told my predator, if I withdrew
> successfully, I'll tap the succubuss club and give him all my
> stuff(Vampires, cards in play, but not pool) prior to my withdraw... Is
> that possible?

No. You withdraw when you reach your untap phase (while meeting all of
the "until your next untap phase" conditions).
